verdict.rationale: Xero can be driven headlessly through its own public API and official SDKs. Custom Connections specifically supports machine-to-machine integrations to a single org, which fits unattended automation, but it is a premium option and nothing documents CI or pipeline use. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/pipeline workflow, details of headless M2M auth setup beyond a starter-app mention, availability outside the premium tier, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
